Whether a person has signed in to Entra, from the two dates of their key

report_first_access.Rd

Phase 1 of the report reads Entra and nothing else, with the permission the round already holds. lastPasswordChangeDateTime is, in the words of Learn, "the time when this Microsoft Entra user last changed their password or when their password was created", and the round creates every account with forceChangePasswordNextSignIn: an account whose key is as old as the account itself is an account nobody has entered.

Usage

report_first_access(directory, upn, tolerance = report_tolerance())

Arguments

directory

A directory frame, as directory_users() returns it.

upn

The person's user principal name.

tolerance

Seconds, report_tolerance() unless a test says otherwise.

Value

One of mai_entrata and entrata, the two a referent is told about; or one of the four that go to IT: disabilitato, non_trovato, senza_creazione (no createdDateTime, which Learn says happens to some accounts created before June 2018) and non_giudicabile.

Details

What it cannot see, said where it is decided. A key reset by IT moves the date without anybody signing in, and the person drops out of the report (phase 2 removes this). An account that existed long before the request has dates that diverge, and the person never shows, even if they never opened the instance asked for: the signal says "has used the UBEP account", not "has used REDCap".
